title: El pantalón
goal: Get trousers taken up and agree when they are ready
culture: Everything gets mended here rather than replaced, and there is a costurera on nearly every block doing it for the price of a coffee. Point at the length you want and name a day: both of those are more reliable than any measurement.

beats.objective: Ask her to take them up
beats.en: Hello. Could you alter this for me?
beats.good: Me lo arregla covers taking up, letting out, patching and mending. Show her the garment and the verb does the rest.
Aquí with a finger on the cloth beats any number of centimetres, and it is what she would rather you did.

beats.es: Va pues. Se lo dejo bien.
beats.objective: Ask when it will be ready
beats.good: ¿Para cuándo? asks the day it will be done. Ask now, because ahorita is not a time and you will be told ahorita.

beats.es: Véngase el jueves, después de las tres.
beats.good: Name the day back and it becomes an appointment. Leave it vague and it becomes Thursday anyway, but you will have walked there twice.
